title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in the former block!
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in the former block! The apartment is suitable for Office, Clinic and Booking. Net area 97m2. It is located on the 3rd floor of an existing building on the edge of the main street, as well as a view from the main street. It is organized by 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, kitchen, living room. Totally restored in detail, walls, plaster ceilings, electrical/hydraulics, doors/windows. Equipped with regular documentation. Price €350,000 Negotiable.
